outputs.explanation: Panel A top shows a bar chart of Cell death (%) reported as mean±s.d. of three independent experiments, but no individual data points are overlaid on the bars.
Panel B top shows a bar chart of Cell death (%); no individual data points are overlaid, and no replicate/error information is shown at all.
Panel C shows grouped bar charts of Cell death (%) at 24/48/72h reported as mean±s.d. of three experiments, but no individual data points are overlaid on the bars.
Panel D top shows a bar chart of Cell death (%) with error bars, but no individual data points are overlaid on the bars.
